decision.fragment:
Goal: Bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis of human airway smooth muscle (ASM) cells treated with the glucocorticoid dexamethasone, from Himes et al. 2014. The 8 libraries come from FOUR independent donor airway smooth muscle cell lines, each assayed both dexamethasone-treated and untreated - a paired/blocked design. Control for the donor cell-line covariate so the estimated dexamethasone effect is not confounded by donor-to-donor baseline differences.
Modality: bulk_rnaseq (bulk RNA-seq)
Organism: Homo sapiens
Desired outputs: Differential expression results table (adjusted p-values + fold-changes), a volcano plot, pathway enrichment (fgsea/GSEA) on the ranked gene list, and a summary report

decision.fragment: 8 libraries from 4 independent donor ASM cell lines, each assayed dexamethasone-treated and untreated (paired/blocked design). Count matrix already registered (counts.tsv 63677x8, samples.csv). Skip upstream sequence trimming, alignment, and quantification. DE model: DESeq2 with formula ~ cell + dex, contrast dex vs untrt, normal-prior LFC shrinkage. Include pathway enrichment (fgsea/GSEA on ranked DE gene list). Desired outputs: DE results table (adjusted p-values + fold-changes), volcano plot, pathway enrichment results, summary report.
